resources.string: Keep this app open in the foreground while the desktop host is connected. Choose QR / LAN or USB below. For screen sharing, approve the Android capture dialog when requested.
USB mode: keep this phone unlocked, start USB Companion on the desktop, then tap Allow. Check USB only rechecks an accessory already started by the desktop.
QR / LAN mode: put both devices on the same trusted private network, generate a QR on the desktop, then scan it here. Google Play services provides the scanner; manual entry remains available.
Or paste the full manual pairing code
Waiting for the desktop to approve a target
Type text for the approved target
